description: Synthetic Plateway fixture for one account holder: six invented restaurants, 36 dishes with option groups and allergen declarations, ten past orders, one in-progress order and one scheduled order. For package validation and examples; not an evaluation task.

sources.description: Synthetic records authored for this package with AI assistance, checked by dev/check-fixture.cjs and reviewed by the contributor; no external collection and no generator script.

review.notes: Automated checks do not replace human review of realism, variation and reuse permissions.
